title: FinPulse — from events to trusted data products
delivery: Helpful, composed product narration. One consistent synthetic voice and natural full sentences. Record the interface to the resulting chapter times.

chapters.title: Meet FinPulse
chapters.text: Meet FinPulse, Alloyce Amos's credit data engineering project. This interactive demo follows synthetic events from their raw source to validated records and useful data products.

chapters.title: Read the operating picture
chapters.text: The overview connects five markets in one operating picture. Counts and quality measures come from the same event pipeline, and each currency keeps its own totals.

chapters.title: Inspect the raw event
chapters.text: Open the event explorer to inspect the original envelope and the related customer events. The source remains visible, so an unexpected metric can be traced back to evidence.

chapters.title: Introduce a controlled problem
chapters.text: Choose the invalid scenario and simulate a new batch. These records enter the raw bronze layer first. The original input stays available before any validation or correction.

chapters.title: Run the processing stages
chapters.text: In the pipeline studio, run the Python validation rules, dimensional loader, and SQL marts. Inspect the processing trace as raw events become validated silver records and gold aggregates.

chapters.title: Review an exception
chapters.text: The quality lab explains each exception. Duplicates are suppressed, while late events can pass with a warning. Invalid records stay in quarantine until a reviewed correction is ready.

chapters.title: Approve and replay
chapters.text: Review a proposed correction and approve its replay. The original raw event is preserved, and the corrected result follows the pipeline again. This makes remediation traceable.

chapters.title: Compare markets carefully
chapters.text: Market insights show counts, ratios, and values by country. Kenyan shillings, Ugandan shillings, Ghanaian cedis, Tanzanian shillings, and Zambian kwacha are kept separate.

chapters.title: Follow the data product
chapters.text: The data product catalogue connects outputs to their lineage. Follow a product through the processing stages, inspect its schema, or export its records for further analysis.

chapters.title: Inspect the engineering
chapters.text: FinPulse demonstrates validation, quality controls, replay, and reporting on synthetic credit data. Explore the working demo and source code; no new real credit decision is made here.
